name: Frigade Assist API product landing page by Frigade Assist API
description: A bright, engineering-literate SaaS landing page built around a single saturated blue accent on white, with realistic product evidence doing the persuasion: a syntax-highlighted code editor paired with a browser mockup showing a highlighted UI element and a 'STEP 1/3' guide tooltip. Below the hero the page alternates rhythm deliberately — wide centered typographic statements ('Your agent has read your docs…') give way to split proof sections, a full-bleed black-vs-blue comparison panel, a dashed-line system diagram with numbered steps, a version timeline that literally shows docs decaying against a blue Frigade line, and stacked list/log cards. Mono uppercase eyebrows, hairline borders, soft floating shadows on mockups and grayscale logo clouds keep it technical and credible, before a rounded royal-blue CTA panel and a dense multi-column footer close the page.
